request:

48x48 pixel frames, transparent background, game-ready sprite sheet, pixel-perfect SNES/GBA style, clean silhouette, limited color palette, sharp pixel clusters, consistent lighting and proportions, compatible with Godot, Unity 2D and RPG Maker., character asset, pixel art, 16bit, HD RPG style, high quality, game sprite
